note: FINAL CANDIDATE -- not yet deployed to production. Combines: (1) regularized/early-stopped CatBoost per horizon (all 7), (2) binary rain-forecast feature for h3/h6/h7 only, (3) post-hoc additive bias correction for h3-h7 only.
prediction_formula: raw_pred = max(current_qin + regressors[h].predict(X), 0); final_pred = max(raw_pred - bias_correction.get(h, 0), 0)

validated_improvement_vs_current_product.methodology: honest holdout: threshold/bias fit on chronological-first 65% of forecast_accuracy_log.csv rows per horizon, evaluated only on the later 35% never used for fitting

refit_recommendation: Refit bias_correction periodically (monthly) as forecast_accuracy_log.csv grows -- current fit uses only 28-32 rows per horizon.
